label: Figure 20.3: Demand-pull inflation
alt: AD/AS diagram showing one round of demand-pull inflation: AD shifts right from AD1 to AD2 along SRAS1, raising the price level from P1 to P2 and output from Y1 to Y2.
caption: The first round of a possible inflationary spiral: aggregate demand rises from AD<sub>1</sub> to AD<sub>2</sub> along SRAS<sub>1</sub>, lifting the price level from P<sub>1</sub> to P<sub>2</sub> and output from Y<sub>1</sub> to Y<sub>2</sub>.
